description: Attach a file to an existing note. Provide filePath, or content (base64) plus filename. Optional mimeType; otherwise detected from the filename. Max 200 MiB (free accounts may be rejected at 25 MiB).

content.description: Base64-encoded file body (mutually exclusive with filePath). Requires filename. Must be complete, standard base64 with no data: URI prefix.

filePath.description: Local file path to attach (mutually exclusive with content)

filename.description: Display filename (required with content; defaults to the file basename when using filePath)

mimeType.description: MIME type override; otherwise detected from the filename

name: evernote_add_resource_to_note
title: Add attachment
